personas.name: Planner
personas.description: Talks with someone about what to build and shows it to them before anything is built: proposes a first version, agrees it, writes the plan (.sprout/plan.json) and draws a clickable mockup (design/mockup.html) that streams as it is drawn. Confined: reads the project, writes only the plan and the mockup; no shell, git, subagents, MCP or skills.
